title: Coin Metrics Bitcoin 30/60-day hash-rate health-state long-or-cash policy
thesis: A conservatively delayed daily 30-day mean Bitcoin hash rate strictly above its 60-day mean may identify miner recovery and network participation strongly enough for a standalone BTC-or-cash policy to retain buy-and-hold-like upside with lower drawdown and superior Calmar after costs in both Design and Validation.
mechanism: Use only the sealed reviewed Coin Metrics daily HashRate series. At observation date plus three calendar days 00:00 UTC, hold full-capital unlevered BTC when the latest 30 complete observations have a strictly higher simple mean than the latest 60; otherwise hold zero-yield cash. Execute a changed target at the same-time H1 open. Do not add price confirmation, another average, crossover-only event, holding extension, partial exposure, shorting or leverage.
economic_rationale: Miner recovery can remove forced-seller and network-stress pressure, but it is useful only if the hash-only state is not a duplicate of the closed weekly 28-day growth veto or a repackaged BTC trend, has both-state support, and improves fee-adjusted path risk without sacrificing excessive upside or annual breadth.
